text:
sana: FYI scheduling a maintenance window for apac-west1 tonight 23:45-01:45 UTC. We'll roll NIC firmware + a kernel driver bump. Expect short node drains and brief enqueueing.

oliver: Noted. Plan suggestion: do 5% canary cohorts, verify KV sync and local replica hit-rate before next cohort. Pause-on-anomaly.

mei: Reserved tenants are on pools `apw1-prod-a` and `apw1-prod-b` 1: do not migrate those. I'll add label `no-evict=true`.

tim: Ops checklist: increase autoscaler min to 0.25 during window, enable backfill to other regions for best-effort only. I'll script the autoscale change.

ops-bot: ALERT-7892 created: "apac-west1 firmware + driver maintenance". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-west1-rolling. Escalation: on-call SRE. Channel reserved: #eng-infra-maint.

oliver: Cost heads-up: cross-region backfill could cost ~ $300-900/hr depending on tail concurrency. Recommend spreading cohorts to avoid 100% tail egress.

mei: Preflight now: `/infra/preflight --region apac-west1 --checks egress,kvcache,replicas` 1 I'll post results.

sana: Proposed timeline: canary 23:45, cohort2 00:05, cohort3 00:25, cohort4 00:45, final sweep 01:35. Each cohort: drain -> update -> bring-up -> 5m watch -> KV reseed.

oliver: Playbook snippet (dry-run recommended):
```
# dry-run rebalance
rebalance --from apac-west1 --to us-east1 --pool best-effort --pct 5 --dry-run
sleep 30
rebalance --commit --pct 5
wait 300
kvcache reseed --pool apac-west1
```

tim: Throttle rule: if p95 latency >1.8x baseline OR error-rate delta >0.5% -> pause + rollback current cohort, notify #eng-infra-maint. File cost ticket if cross-region spend > $1.2k.

mei: I'll create a temporary policy `no-cross=true` for `reserved:true` pools and validate in preflight.

oliver: Also switching smart-routing fallback to prefer same-region replicas when rtt <100ms; if rtt spikes or packet-loss >0.2% failover to remote. Patch will be toggled at cohort boundaries.

sana: I'll send customer notice at 18:30 UTC with opt-out for dedicated customers. Add extra tracing and retention for window.

ops-bot: Deploy: driver-update job queued (20 hosts). Status: queued.

tim: I'll be in #eng-infra-maint and on-call phone during the window. Ping me if any cohort shows >2x CPU or sustained enqueue backlog.

sana: Thanks team. If no objections by 22:30 UTC I'll lock the schedule. :thumbsup:
